reason: £300 for four 17s sounds fine, but it's a new seller with no reviews and nothing says tyres are included, so I'd be paying extra on top. I'd rather buy from someone with proof of their work.
objection: New seller with no reviews, and no mention of tyres. If I have to buy tyres on top, the saving is gone, and I can't tell how good the refinishing is.
would_change_my_mind: Photos of previous sets and real reviews, plus tyres with good tread included in the £300, or a chance to see the wheels in person before paying.
